mview.hint: Click a move to watch it: the replay jumps to where it starts and the camera shows who made it.
mview.summary: {n, plural, one {# move found in this match.} other {# moves found in this match.}}
mview.res.escaped: Worked: the missile missed and they got away.
mview.res.shotDown: Didn't work: shot down {secs} s later.
mview.res.stillFlying: They were still flying a minute later.
mview.res.worked: Worked: from {from} to {to} they took out {kills} and lost {losses}.
mview.res.failed: Didn't work: from {from} to {to} they lost {losses} and took out {kills}.
mview.res.even: Even: from {from} to {to} they took out {kills} and lost {losses}.
mview.res.none: Nothing happened: nobody was taken out from {from} to {to}.
mview.res.counts: From {from} to {to} they took out {kills} and lost {losses}.
mview.res.withdrew: Worked: they lost fewer units after pulling back than before.
mview.res.stillLosing: Didn't work: they kept losing units after pulling back.
mview.res.encircled: Worked: {lost} of the {of} surrounded enemies were taken out.
mview.res.captures: They also took {n, plural, one {# objective} other {# objectives}}.
mview.dodge.shown: After {foe} fired, {who} flew {how} for {secs} s while the missile was flying at them.
mview.dodge.late: After {foe} fired, {who} flew {how} for {secs} s, but not while the missile was in the air, so it may not have been to dodge it.
mview.dodge.unseen: After {foe} fired, {who} flew {how} for {secs} s. The data doesn't show the missile, so we can't tell if they did it on purpose.
mview.how.crank: at an angle of about 40-70° to the shooter
mview.how.pump: away from the shooter and then back towards them
mview.plain.crank: Flew at an angle to the shooter
mview.mean.formation: Moving together in a set shape (a line, a column, a wedge) so they can help each other.
mview.mean.frontalAssault: Driving straight at the enemy from the front.
mview.mean.flank: Going around to hit the enemy from the side or from behind, where they are weaker.
mview.mean.pincer: Two groups hitting the enemy from two sides at once.
mview.mean.encirclement: Surrounding enemies so they have no way out.
mview.mean.penetration: Pushing through a gap in the enemy's line to get behind it.
mview.mean.bounding: Moving in turns: some move while the others stay ready to shoot, then they swap.
mview.mean.concentration: Bringing many units together at one spot to be stronger there.
mview.mean.dispersion: Spreading out so one attack can't hit many of them at once.
mview.mean.feint: A move that looks like an attack in one place while the real push comes somewhere else.
mview.mean.withdrawal: Pulling back out of the fight.
mview.mean.pursuit: Chasing enemies who are pulling back.
mview.mean.defenceInDepth: Defending in layers, one behind the other, so an enemy who breaks through meets more defenders.
mview.mean.reverseSlope: Waiting just behind the top of a hill, so the enemy only sees them when it is close.
mview.mean.ambush: Waiting out of sight, then opening fire when enemies come close.
mview.mean.screen: A few units out in front to spot the enemy early for the rest.
mview.mean.interiorLines: Staying in the middle, so getting from one fight to the next is quicker for them than for the enemy going around.
mview.mean.tempo: Reacting faster than the enemy: moving again before the enemy has answered the last move.
mview.mean.crank: Flying at an angle (about 40-70°) to whoever fired a missile, so the missile has to fly further and may run out of speed.
mview.mean.notch: Flying sideways (about 90°) to whoever fired, which can make their radar lose you.
mview.mean.drag: Turning round and flying straight away from whoever fired, so the missile has to chase you.
mview.mean.pump: Turning away from whoever fired, then turning back towards them.
mview.mean.airPincer: Two aircraft coming at one enemy from two sides.
mview.mean.wall: Aircraft flying side by side in a line.
mview.mean.leadTrail: One aircraft in front and another following behind it.
mview.mean.grinder: Aircraft taking turns: one goes in to fight while the other turns away, round and round.
mview.mean.cap: Circling over an area to guard it.
mview.mean.energyFight: Fighting with speed and height: diving in to shoot, then climbing away.
mview.mean.anglesFight: Fighting by turning hard to get behind the enemy.
mview.mean.strikePackage: Aircraft flying together to attack targets on the ground.
mview.mean.sead: Attacking the enemy's anti-air first, before the main attack comes in.
mview.mean.lineOfBattle: Ships in one line so they can all fire to the side.
mview.mean.crossingT: Crossing in front of the enemy's line, so all your ships can fire while only their front ones can fire back.
